$comment: Corpus plan + provenance for the AFE quality harness (issue #247, slice A). The corpus is SYNTHETIC and derived from these parameters by device/tests/quality/corpus.cxx -- no audio is committed (ADR-027 spirit), and the generator is the artifact. pyroomacoustics / ssspy are test-only oracles (ADR-048 13) and are not required by this suite.

determinism.note: libc rand() is implementation-defined, so it is deliberately not used. Same parameters -> identical samples on every platform, which is what lets the thresholds be gates rather than commentary.

clips.name: noise-pink-a
clips.note: ground truth: no signal to protect, so whatever survives is residual noise

thresholds.$comment: Loose enough for int16 rounding and platform drift, tight enough that a stage which is not working at all cannot pass. Verified against the known-bad control, which the harness must reject.

negativeControl.fault: 16 kHz audio mislabeled as 48 kHz into the 48 kHz model (#240 B2)
negativeControl.requirement: must FAIL; the wrapper inverts the exit code, so a vacuous gate fails CI

baseline.$comment: Observed on the shipped RNNoise stage (v0.1.1, gcc, x86-64). Platform drift is expected; the gate is the threshold, not this number.
